description: Search the providers whose listings Aura Historia indexes (dealers, auction houses, marketplaces and auction platforms) by name. Without a query it browses all providers; a query too short to match returns no results. Returns 1 to 50 providers per page (default 21); pass the returned searchAfter unchanged, with the same query and size, to get the next page. Each result's `viewLink.url` is the provider link meant to be shared with people: it carries Aura Historia's referral tagging, which is lost when its query parameters are changed. `viewLink.affiliate` is `true` when that link is an affiliate link, which can earn Aura Historia a commission. `url` is the provider's untagged address.

query.description: Optional source-name text; omission or whitespace browses, insufficient text returns no matches.

searchAfter.description: Continuation from the previous page: pass back exactly as returned, with the same `query` and `size`.

size.description: Number of providers per page, from 1 to 50 (default 21); continuations are bound to the query and page size.

name: searchPublicListingSources

url.description: The provider's own address, without Aura Historia's referral tagging; `viewLink.url` is the link meant to be shared.

viewLink.description: The link to the provider's page that is meant to be shared with people, and whether it is an affiliate link.

PublicListingSourceOperatorData.description: The Party that operates a ListingSource, as shown wherever a source is presented publicly.

partner.description:
`true` while the operator Party has an active Aura Historia Partnership, otherwise
`false`, including after a Partnership is dissolved. Unrelated to ingestion methods and
referral configuration.

ViewLinkData.description: The provider link meant to be shared with people, paired with whether it is an affiliate link.

affiliate.description: `true` when `url` is an affiliate link, which can earn Aura Historia a commission when people follow it. `false` when it carries only Aura Historia's tracking parameters or leads to Aura Historia itself.

url.description: Link to the provider's page that is meant to be shared with people. It carries Aura Historia's referral tagging, which is lost when its query parameters are changed.
